annotations.title: Start uploading a custom mod or plugin file

description: Only for an assistant that can send the user's file with HTTP PUT, such as a coding agent with a shell. Begins uploading one .jar or .zip mod, plugin, datapack or resource pack (up to 512 MiB, storage capped per server and account) and returns uploadId, key, fileName and parts: PUT each piece within an hour and keep each ETag. Then completeAssetUploads installs mods, plugins and datapacks, inspectAssetUpload checks a file or readies a resource pack for setResourcePack, and abortAssetUploads discards it.

fileName.description: File name with extension, e.g. mymod.jar.

replace.description: Replace the uploaded file that already has this name. Its entry keeps its place and disabled state and takes the new file once the upload completes.

serverId.description: Server id: the id field from listServers.

name: startAssetUpload
